author: CBR
description:
Tim McDonald explains why Homelander works so well in The Boys and why Invincible hits so hard with Omni-Man. 

He breaks down Homelander as a celebrity with godlike power and no consequences, why The Boys TV series elevated the comic’s ideas, and how Invincible turns the classic superhero mentor story into something much darker through Mark Grayson and Omni-Man.
